newsitem.title: CHINA: China unit oil output 3.51 mln T Jan-March.
newsitem.headline: China unit oil output 3.51 mln T Jan-March.

text.p: China Offshore Oil Nanhai East Corp produced 3.51 million tonnes of crude oil from the South China Sea in the first quarter of the year, the China Daily said on Saturday.
It said this was 220,000 tonnes above the target for the quarter though it did not give a figure for the same period last year.
The company is one of four subsidiaries of the China National Offshore Oil Corp, which oversees offshore oil and natural gas exploration.
The company expects to produce 11.03 million tonnes of oil this year, the newspaper said.
